body:
WDYM?

As I understand it, it's needed for Angular because it creates web components. Those are not targetable with the `*` selector.
Fixed in 1ddb6fe9343ae223bf4f4206fd42eb55eff6012d using `position: fixed;`.
This makes the inputs font size at `16px`, which is the fix for mobile browsers on iOS to not zoom on the inputs.
This makes the buttons in the input more accessible on mobile: it increases the touch area.
